title: DARTree: Speculative Diffusion Decoding with Autoregressive Draft Trees
abstract: arXiv:2608.13524v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding losslessly accelerates autoregressive language models by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel. Diffusion-based drafters further reduce proposal latency by predicting an entire token block in parallel, but their position-wise distributions are marginal rather than conditioned on tokens selected along each draft path. Existing recurrent correction incorporates causal information along a single draft chain, whereas diffusion-based tree construction broadens candidate coverage without carrying this correction along individual branches. We introduce DARTree, a training-free speculative decoding method that extends a pretrained AR correction head from chains to trees. translated_title: DARTree：基于自回归草稿树的投机性扩散解码
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13524v1 公告类型：新 摘要：投机性解码通过并行验证多个草稿令牌，无损地加速自回归语言模型。基于扩散的起草器通过并行预测整个令牌块来进一步减少提议延迟，但它们的位置分布是边缘分布，而不是沿每条草稿路径选择的令牌条件分布。现有的递归校正沿单条草稿链引入因果信息，而基于扩散的树构建扩展了候选覆盖范围，但未沿各个分支携带这种校正。我们引入了DARTree，一种无需训练的投机性解码方法，将预训练的自回归校正头从链扩展到树。DARTree首先通过单批扩展和评分每个深度的所有节点来构建固定宽度的候选树，然后仅应用最佳优先剪枝来选择验证树，将自回归头的推理与顺序堆操作解耦。
tldr: DARTree是一种无需训练的投机解码方法，通过将自回归校正头从链扩展到树，实现了高效并行验证，提升了扩散式解码的速度与准确性。
en_tdlr: DARTree is a training-free speculative decoding method that extends autoregressive correction heads from chains to trees, enabling efficient parallel verification and improving speed and accuracy in diffusion-based decoding.
